## Summary

A clear and concise description of the feature.

## Motivation

What problem does this solve?

## Proposal

Describe the desired behavior and any UI/workflow impacts.

## Notes

- If this involves Power Platform artifacts, note whether the change should be implemented in the Canvas app, Power Automate, SharePoint schema, or solution structure.
- Avoid including secrets/PII.
